no_elections_reason: Vatican City has no popular elections and no political parties. The only selection of the head of state is the papal conclave of the College of Cardinals, held on a vacancy (in the period covered: Benedict XVI elected 19 April 2005, Francis 13 March 2013, Leo XIV 8 May 2025). Conclaves are not recorded as elections because ballots are secret and no vote counts are published; their outcomes are carried by the vat.pope holder list, and the office's succession type (council_choice) covers future vacancies.
